features.agent: Ask in plain language — "What access does María have to GitHub?" or "Give Pedro read access to Jira." Responses stream in real time, with every tool call shown as it happens.
features.approvals: Access requests for sensitive resources waiting on a decision. Approve or reject them — the permission doesn't change until then.
features.audit: The full trail — what was requested, whether it was granted, denied, or sent for approval, and whether an admin or the agent did it.
features.employees: Browse the team and open any employee to see, and change, their access to every company resource.
features.overview: Live counts and a feed of the most recent actions across the whole system.
features.permissions: Every active grant across the organization, in one sortable table.
features.policies: The actual rule catalog the Policy Engine enforces. Deactivate a rule and watch what the agent and the UI are allowed to do change immediately.
features.resources: The applications, environments, and infrastructure access can be granted to, including which ones are marked sensitive.

learn.intro: Axalot is an internal IAM (identity and access management) console. An administrator reviews or changes what employees can access — through the UI or by talking to an AI agent in plain language. The agent can look things up and propose changes, but a deterministic backend decides what's actually allowed.
